text:
sam_partnerships: Quick sync: we're kicking off a slim gateway adapter onramp with ToolX + LangChain tomorrow 10am PT. Goal: validate connector, define compatibility matrix, and co-announce plan. Need eng, SDK, docs, and marketing.

leila_eng: Adding eng infra and runtime folks. Is there an initial spec we can review?

sam_partnerships: Yep, link to draft spec in repo: https://git.redwood.com/toolx/adapter-spec-v0.3 (internal). Agenda draft below.

maria_pm: Can you drop agenda in thread? I'll add goals and success metrics.

sam_partnerships: ```
Agenda
- 10m intros + context
- 20m adapter contract & model routes
- 20m performance SLOs (latency/cost targets)
- 15m integration demo + smoke test
- 15m next steps + PRs
```

aj_dev: I'll own the smoke test. Need sample payloads from ToolX.

nate_sdk: SDK: we'll provide `toolx-connector` npm package and a quickstart. ETA EOD today for beta build.

olivia_marketing: Marketing: to prep joint announcement, need expected timeline and customer quote. Can we pin a target release week?

sam_partnerships: Targeting week of Apr 12 (tentative). We'll aim to have a beta usable by then. @nate_sdk can you confirm SDK cadence?

nate_sdk: :thumbsup: EOD beta. Will post a test harness link here when ready.

leila_eng: On perf SLOs — we need to know expected QPS and seq length. @sam_partnerships can you check with ToolX?

sam_partnerships: On it. Also created calendar invite: <https://calendar.example/meeting/1768009999>

calendarbot: Event created by sam_partnerships: ToolX adapter onramp — Tomorrow 10:00 PT. Guests: leila_eng, aj_dev, maria_pm, nate_sdk, olivia_marketing.

aj_dev: Quick note: smoke test command (to run against staging):
```
curl -sS -X POST "https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate" \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \ 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b","input":"test connector flow"}'
```

deploy_bot: Staging environment provisioned for ToolX adapter testing: infra/adapter-staging-12

maria_pm: I'll compile success metrics doc and link it here later today.

sam_partnerships: Thanks all. If anyone can't make the call, post blockers in thread. We'll record.
